text: The extent of motor unit activation likely depends on the magnitude of load. During heavy-load training, the highest-threshold motor units are recruited almost immediately, whereas during lighter-load training, the recruitment of these motor units is delayed. The point at which complete motor unit activation occurs is not clear, but evidence suggests that a majority of the motor unit pool for a working muscle is recruited with loads as low as 30% of 1RM, provided sets are carried out with a high intensity of effort (158). Thus, a high intensity of effort becomes increasingly important as the intensity of loading is reduced.
